portraits.name: Gregor Eisenhorn
portraits.background: An austere Inquisitorial investigation office, entirely unlike the current cathedral. Dim amber-gold practical light from a shaded brass lamp; aged dark timber, distant shelves of closed case folios and sealed evidence boxes, one restrained Ordo insignia as a softly resolved background motif. Layered shadows and a warm dull-gold atmosphere indicate Inquisition allegiance. No arched cathedral, no skull-lined columns, no repeating candles. Keep the environment blurred and behind his shoulder silhouette.

Dim amber-gold practical light from a shaded brass lamp; aged dark timber, distant shelves of closed case folios and sealed evidence boxes, one restrained Ordo insignia as a softly resolved background motif. portraits.name: Gideon Ravenor
portraits.background: A spacious Inquisitorial command observatory on a starship. Behind the sealed chair: a broad curved viewport showing a dark star field and a faint pale planet, with muted amber-gold tactical instruments and old brass architectural framing off to the sides. Gold accents signal Inquisition allegiance. The floor remains a continuous dark metallic deck beneath the chair's visible hovering base; do not place the chair in outer space. No cathedral arches, no candles, no skull-lined columns. Make it quiet, cerebral and austere rather than a battlefield.

portraits.name: Harlon Nayl
portraits.background: A practical retinue armoury aboard a gun-cutter. Background gun racks are out-of-focus dark utilitarian silhouettes, weathered cargo lockers, ammunition cases and a faint cyan overhead utility strip, grey-blue industrial metal and smoky depth. Cyan accents signal an Inquisitorial field agent, not a gold-robed official. No cathedral, no ornamental skull wall, no candles. The equipment must stay behind the character, not alter his harness or add a held weapon.

portraits.name: Kara Swole
portraits.background: A covert retinue infiltration vantage in a rain-soaked hive city: an elevated covered service balcony, distant staggered industrial windows and gantries behind her, desaturated blue-cyan urban light scattered through mist, muted warm glimmers far away. Cyan accents tie her to the retinue while the athletic infiltrator setting distinguishes her from the gunman's armoury. No cathedral, no skull columns, no circus props, no readable signs. Keep rain in the distant background, not across her face or clothing.

portraits.name: Cherubael
portraits.background: A shadowed daemon-binding vault: cracked black-violet stone, an indistinct containment circle only in the BACKGROUND behind the shoulders, thin violet haze gathered in recesses and faint unnatural purple light without flashy lightning. Empty ominous space and wrong-feeling depth signal daemon allegiance. His service to a radical Inquisitor is suggested only by the austere containment architecture; no conventional Imperial cathedral mural or gold devotional candles. No additional creatures, no gore, no new ward markings or symbols on his body. Background marks are abstract, never readable text.

portraits.name: Patience Kys
portraits.background: A covert-agent transit gantry on an industrial hive rooftop at blue hour: slender dark steel supports, a softly resolved horizontal maintenance catwalk, distant slate towers and one tiny cyan utility beacon in cool mist. A spare, tense surveillance location suited to Ravenor's telekinetic assassin, NOT a glowing psychic ritual. Retinue-cyan environmental accents, no cathedral arches, no skull motifs, no neon nightclub, no floating weapons, no alterations to her hairpins.

portraits.name: Alizebeth Bequin
portraits.background: The Distaff's quiet safehouse training room, an austere interior with frosted blue-gray partition glass and a small distant plain door, a narrow daylight slit and a discreet muted cyan status light. Still, orderly, low-tech restraint suited to the leader of Eisenhorn's blank cadre. No visible magic, no aura or halo, no distortion around her body. No cathedral, skull-lined wall or ornate candles. Preserve warm facial light while the room has a quiet subdued retinue-blue palette.

portraits.name: Uber Aemos
portraits.background: An Inquisitorial retinue research archive and cogitator alcove: stacked old books and folded star charts, dark shelves with varied depths, a recessed faint blue-cyan data-screen glow, one soft amber desk-lamp pool distant behind the shoulder. An eccentric scholarly workplace, not a cathedral and not a spaceship cockpit. Retinue-cyan technology accents within warm tobacco-brown library materials. No readable screen text or book titles, no extra characters, no new equipment attached to his spectacles.

revisions.background: An Inquisitorial retinue research archive and cogitator alcove: stacked old books and folded star charts, dark shelves with varied depths, a recessed faint blue-cyan data-screen glow, one soft amber desk-lamp pool distant behind the shoulder. portraits.name: Medea Betancore
portraits.background: A unmistakably functional Glavian gun-cutter cockpit: asymmetrical weathered instrument panels softly out of focus behind her shoulders, a side canopy window opening onto a large cool-blue launch hangar, restrained cyan instrument lights and steel struts instead of gothic pillars. Her inherited flight jacket remains exactly as it is. Retinue allegiance expressed through muted cyan avionic lights and operational hardware, not gold religious iconography. No cathedral, no skull mural, no candles, no readable cockpit text, no altered seat or harness in the foreground.

portraits.name: Carl Thonius
portraits.background: A refined retinue interrogator's diplomatic study: dark polished wood panelling, a tall rectangular rain-streaked window admitting subdued blue-cyan evening light, a distant closed compact cogitator on a writing desk and a faint warm lamp reflection. Elegant, controlled civilian-facing working space rather than an armoury or cathedral. Retinue-cyan accents are subtle and sophisticated. No gold throne-room symbolism, skull columns, wall of candles, readable text or added hands; preserve his red velvet, lace and distinctive blond hair unchanged.
